items.text: Malik Nabers is active for SNF after murky/up-to-him status and PS elevations.
items.why: Knee; full practice but late decision
items.implication: Start everywhere; risk of decoy limited

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere as Cards wouldn't activate if worried about ankle.
items.why: Expected to play reports confirmed active

items.text: Rome Odunze officially active today after expected-to-play reports on calf.
items.why: Calf injury but expected and confirmed active
items.implication: Start with confidence in Bears offense

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL) not expected to play and officially inactive vs Lions; full participant late week but not ready.
items.why: MCL sprain not fully ready despite practice
items.opportunity: Bulk work and pass-downs for Etienne

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest), Brian Thomas Jr (shoulder), Kyler Murray (concussion), others including Lane/Cooper.
items.implication: Monitor severity for Week 2; Flowers big for BAL

items.text: Zay Flowers left early with hamstring; watching for severity.
items.why: In-game hamstring exit after big performance
items.implication: BAL WR targets to others short-term

items.text: Ladd McConkey left early with chest injury.
items.implication: LAC WR depth test; monitor Week 2

items.text: Starting Malik Nabers wherever owned post-active; risk/reward as possible decoy but play him.
Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled OUT wrist injury; initial fracture diagnosis, MRI next, several weeks.
items.why: Wrist injury in game; fracture likely
items.implication: Ravens WR depth thins further with Flowers exit

items.text: AJ Brown high ankle sprain no surgery needed but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.implication: IR candidate; NE WR depth up

items.text: Brock Bowers (meniscus trim) OUT Week 1 but realistic chance return Week 2 at Chargers; team monitoring feel.
items.why: Meniscus surgery Tuesday; short absence possible

items.text: Main slate news locked; Nabers (Q knee) murky/up to him for SNF; Giants elevated Berrios/Cambre from PS. Projections updating, no other major changes.
items.why: Late decision pending; PS moves signal caution
items.implication: Monitor closely pre-SNF; pivot if out

items.text: Weekend reports: Love/Odunze expected to play; Kamara not expected; Josh Williams activated (Tucker doubtful); Nabers no news yet. Kamara status impacts Etienne proj.
items.implication: Main slate mostly locked; adjust Etienne up

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season well under way.
Combine Flowers/McConkey/Thomas/Murray/etc with Bowers (knee), AJ Brown (ankle), Darnold (hip), Stribling (ankle); not a clean start for injuries.
Buy low on Colston Loveland; preseason wanted Bears offense share and that hasn't changed despite Week 1 weirdness/targets to Kmet/Raymond.
items.why: Preseason belief in Bears TE role intact

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not; preseason talk with new OC Sean Mannion from Packers coming over.
Joey Porter Jr officially inactive (back) vs Falcons; contract dispute and trade possibility remain.
